list_child.name: list_roast_batches
list_child.desc: Returns the complete list of roast batches currently tracked by the roastery, from queued green coffee through shipped orders. Use this for a full view of what's moving through the roaster.

get_child.name: get_roast_batch
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single roast batch record by its identifier, including its current phase and ship date. Use this when you already know which batch you need instead of scanning the full list.

list_parent.name: list_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns every wholesale client the roastery currently supplies, whether they order weekly or only occasionally. This is the complete client roster on file.

get_parent.name: get_client
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single client record by its identifier, pulling up their contact details and order history. Use this when you need information on one specific account.

delete_child.name: purge_roast_batch
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a roast batch record from the system, and this cannot be undone once it runs. Only use this for batches that were logged by mistake or never actually roasted.

set_enum.name: set_batch_phase
set_enum.desc: Moves a roast batch to a new phase, covering queued, roasting, cooling, or shipped. This is how the roastery keeps its production board accurate as green coffee turns into a shipped order.

set_bool.name: flag_recall
set_bool.desc: Marks a roast batch as recalled, pulling it out of normal fulfillment. This should only be used when there is a genuine quality concern with the batch.

set_ref.name: move_client
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a roast batch from one client to another, which is useful when an order gets transferred between accounts. The batch keeps its full roast history after the move.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends an email to the contact on file for a wholesale client. Use this when a batch needs a written update instead of a quick internal note.

sort.sup_phrase: the roast batch with the earliest ship date
sort.ord_phrase: the roast batch with the {ord} earliest ship date
